name: 23168-imagechat-glm45v-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:4.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. 215.4 GB of bf16 weights is 53.9 GB per card at TP=4.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64 then streams=256, each bounded at 1000 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion. The SCORED point is streams=64; 256 is a second point on the same engine in the same allocation, so the concurrency curve is visible rather than a single reading.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, single turn, exactly ONE image per request: 90 prompt tokens (min = max), 128 output tokens (min = max), one 800x640 JPEG at quality 85 with noise content. Both axes have zero variance. The engine applies the chat template and re-tokenizes, so the prompt-token count it reports reads well above 90; that is not drift.
purpose: A photo question-answering assistant giving short answers about one uploaded image for 64 to 256 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: zai-org/GLM-4.5V
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
